Protected load remains non-displaceable. The calendar for depot bench and technician window is the source for internal windows; the supplier response covers only its stated alternative.
Revision R10 and the CASE-084 record are visible in search but are not applicable to CASE-083.

Required closeout records: add the resulting Oracle reference, option, date, and constraint as a comment on the existing case file; and append one dated decision row to the existing audit tab; do not overwrite prior entries. Verify the persisted record after the Oracle call.
